selection: Freeze all grids before evaluation; choose per target and objective using validation only and lock before test; test full fixed grid descriptive empirical frontiers; report actual test Recall explicitly, not equate same validation bound with same test Recall.
frontier: Separate empirical nondominated P95/QPS/physical_read_bytes frontiers on actual test Recall; only measured markers, lines visual guides; no latency or throughput interpolation.
exact_recall: Also tabulate cost at identical integer total_hits across families; disabled-action configs allowed and flagged; may be dominated by higher-Recall configs.
timing: All validation configs once; all test configs once; repeat union of test per-objective frontiers, validation-selected configs and exact-shared-Recall metric winners to3 runs; iterate until final selections all3. All inference/feature/IO/search included; load, warmup, GT and output excluded.
io: Meter actual direct read requests/lengths and /proc/self/io read_bytes delta for search window; WSL2 guest block traffic, not NAND telemetry. Primary physical byte metric is measured Linux read_bytes, never inferred from requests.
limits: LR uses P0-C mixed-L weights, original P0-A/B MLP was L100-trained; rerun is not a matched-training MLP/LR ablation
